description: This Java class implements a ResultSetExtractor to parse SQL query results into a list of Grouping objects, where each Grouping contains entities and their associated actions, organized hierarchically.

classes.name: EventResultSetExtractor
classes.description: A class that extracts and processes SQL result set data into structured grouping objects.

methods.name: extractData
methods.description: Processes the SQL ResultSet to create a list of Grouping objects, each containing entities with sorted actions.
